पृच्छक mf(इका)n. (√ प्रछ्) one who asks or inquires about (gen.), Yājñ.; Śak.; Pañc.
पृच्छक m. an inquirer, inquisitive person, W.

पृच्छ्य mfn. to be asked or inquired after, BhP.
